review.notes: Triage review of all 77 physical pages. Full structural scan: exactly three code fences (three ```txt prompt-box quotes on physical p.6 region of the OCR, lines 285-295), balanced with no swallowed headings; 49 image embeds; all printed Figure captions 1-47 present in the OCR and none extra; the 0-containment pages (physical 24-26, 40, 42, 59, 61, 62, 65) are full-page two-figure chart spreads whose only text layer content is the caption pair. Automated normalized 4-gram containment of every PDF page's text layer against the OCR markdown: low-containment prose/tables pages (6, 7, 9, 10-14, 16, 36, 47, 70, 71) resolve to numeric benchmark tables whose sampled values (0.955, 1.000, 46.2, 3616, 0.649, 0.423, 0.900, 0.952) all exist in the OCR HTML tables, plus the three dropped page-bottom footnote bodies repaired below. Footnote scan via small-font (<=9.1pt) bottom-of-page lines found exactly three footnote areas in the document (fn1 p.6, fn2 p.7, fn3 p.9); all three bodies were dropped by the OCR while their $^{n}$ markers survive inline. Rendered physical p.6, p.7 and p.9 footnote regions at 300 dpi and transcribed the bodies against the renders (fn3's display math linearized: R = r_sim/r_prod, k_eff = (1/k_prod + 1/k_sim)^-1, bounds ±1.645/ln 2, Var(log_2 R) ≈ 1/((ln 2)^2 k_eff), H_0: r_sim = r_prod - all read from the render). Patches use the document's own $^{n}$ marker spelling and \_ escape convention (straight quotes per document convention; printed hyperlinks kept as plain text like the rest of the document). Line-by-line review covered the diff contexts of flagged pages; remaining pages matched at >=0.82 containment. Replay verified: all three before-strings occur exactly once after prior patches, and the image-embed sequence is unchanged. Rendered p.6 bottom (300 dpi, y 600+), p.7 bottom (300 dpi, y 655+) and p.9 bottom (300 dpi, y 610+) PNGs and read them to transcribe and verify the three footnote bodies.

$^{3}$ Mathematically, we plot log\_2 R, where R = r\_sim / r\_prod, against the effective positive count k\_eff = (1 / k\_prod + 1 / k\_sim)^-1, with sampling-noise bounds ±1.645 / ln 2 because Var(log\_2 R) ≈ 1 / ((ln 2)^2 k\_eff). Falling outside these bounds corresponds to rejecting H\_0: r\_sim = r\_prod using an approximate two-sided Wald test at the 10% significance level. The plotted confidence region does not leverage the paired nature of samples and resamples, which may lead it to be overly wide. Intervals based on paired-samples did not seem to meaningfully change the borders while introducing additional mathematical complexity.
